title: Understanding P-Trap Water Seal Protection
description: The primary purpose of a P-trap is to maintain a standing water barrier, known as the trap seal, which blocks harmful sewer gases from rising into occupied spaces. However, if a P-trap is installed without proper venting or with an improperly proportioned trap arm, self-siphonage can occur. As wastewater rushes down the drain line, it creates a negative atmospheric pressure that pulls the trapped water seal out along with it. To protect the trap seal, ensure the trap arm is correctly sized and properly connected to a vented drain line according to local plumbing standards.
